title: A Power that Drives Away Despair

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Rino and her friends are facing off against the Black King. The flames of battle were finally lit.
text_block_list.orig_text:
黒の王と相対するリノたち。
ついに戦いの火蓋が切られるのだった。

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: At last, the final battle... let's get this started! Onii-chan, please!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ついに最終決戦……
一気にいきましょう！
お兄ちゃん、
お願いします！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much, Onii-chan!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうございます、
お兄ちゃん！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: ...This ability of his never stops being incredible.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……相変わらず、
とんでもない能力ですよ。

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: You can say that again... what an interesting power♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当、
興味深い力だよね～♪

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Heh-heh! Such an attack won't hit me now! I'll retaliate with a scratching attack! UNYANYANYANYAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっへ～んだ！
そんな攻撃当たらないよ！
お返しの引っかき攻撃！
　
うにゃにゃにゃにゃ～～！！

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr...
text_block_list.orig_text: グルルルゥ……

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? That didn't work at all?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
あれ？
全然効いてない？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Then, it's time to make way for my breath attack!
text_block_list.orig_text: だったらあたしのブレスの出番です！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Lago, please♪ Join her in that☆
text_block_list.orig_text:
ラーゴもお願い♪
やっちゃって☆

text_block_list.name: Lago
text_block_list.text: Gyao!
text_block_list.orig_text: ギャオッ！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: I'll turn you into a DAMN GRILLED FROG!
text_block_list.orig_text: 焼きガエルにしてやるですよ～！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: What do you think of that!! Are you well cooked and ready to eat now!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうですか！！
上手に焼けて食べ頃ですか！！

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: Grrrrrr...
text_block_list.orig_text: グルルルゥ……

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hmm, let me see... I guess it's below rare, maybe blue rare~?
text_block_list.orig_text:
う～ん、
そうだね～
レアより下の、
ブルーレアってとこかな～？

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Rino! Let us join the fray too!
text_block_list.orig_text:
リノ！
あたしたちもいくわよ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Yes! GOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい！
いっけぇぇぇぇええええ～～！！！

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Yay! That just now was a decisive bl-... Huh?
text_block_list.orig_text:
やった！
今のは完璧に決まって……
え？

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: No way... Even with that he's unharmed...!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな……
これでも無傷だなんて……！？

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hmm~ The attacks themselves seem to be hitting, but it feels like they're also being absorbed~? This might be a bit dangerous♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～
攻撃自体は当たってるんだけど、
なんだか
吸収されてるみたいな感じかな～？
これは
ちょ～っと
やばいかも♪

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Wh-What's this? It feels like the Black King's gotten bigger...
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なに？
黒の王が大きくなったような……

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Hiyori-san! He's coming your way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ヒヨリさん！
そっちに行きましたよ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Don't worry, it's all right~♪ His movements are not that fast...
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいじょぶだいじょぶ～♪
動きはそんなに速くないから……

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Suddenly he's faster than before!?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ……
さっきより全然速い！？

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: H-Hold still, TIMEEEE!
text_block_list.orig_text:
じ、
時間よ
止まれ～！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Hah, hah... That was close...! P-Please get away while you still can!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ、
はぁ……
危なかったです……！
い、
今のうちに
離れてください～！

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Ayumi-chan! If it wasn't for Ayumi-chan's timely attack, I would've been completely defeated...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとうアユミちゃん！
アユミちゃんがいなかったら、
完全にやられてたよ……

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: As I thought, that strength of his is just nonsense...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱり、
でたらめな強さなのです……

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: As expected of one wearing the title of "King"~
text_block_list.orig_text:
さすが
『王』と呼ばれるだけのことはあるね～

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: W-Will we really... be able to win...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
私たち、
勝てるでしょうか……？

text_block_list.name: Black King
text_block_list.text: ...GUOOOH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: アリス
text_block_list.text:
また大きくなった！
これは、
もしかして……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
また大きくなった！
これは、
もしかして……！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Everyone, listen!! He's growing stronger by feeding on everyone's anxiety and despair... the darkness in your hearts!
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな聞いて！！
あいつは、
みんなの不安や絶望を……
心の闇を食べて強くなっているんだわ！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: The darkness... in my heart...? Um, does that mean that if I believe my attacks won't work, he'll grow stronger by the mere thought of my anxiety over them not working...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
心の、
闇……？
えとえと、
それってもしかして、
攻撃が効かないって
思ったら
思っただけ
強くなっちゃうってことですか……！？

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: There's no way we can win against something like that, you know!?
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなの絶対に勝てないですよ！？

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: You have nothing to fear!! All you have to do is use the power that is the polar opposite of his... the power of hope!! If you do that, I'm sure you'll be able to seal him away!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
安心して！！
　あいつと正反対の力を……
希望の想いの力をぶつければいいのよ！！
そうすればきっと、
あいつを封じられるわ！！

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: Therefore, please! Everyone, lend me your power... the power of hope!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だからお願い！
みんなの力を……
希望の想いの力を貸して！！

text_block_list.name: Inori
text_block_list.text: Hmph! You don't need to ask me twice!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふんっ！
言われるまでもないです！！

text_block_list.name: Homare
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Sure, that sounds fun! ♪
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
なんだか面白そうだね～♪

text_block_list.name: Hiyori
text_block_list.text: All right, I'll do my best!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よーし、
あたし頑張っちゃうよ～！

text_block_list.name: Ayumi
text_block_list.text: Hope... My hope... Um... Ummmmm...
text_block_list.orig_text:
希望……
私の希望……
えっと……
えっとぉぉぉお……

text_block_list.name: Alice
text_block_list.text: All right...! Let's do this, Rino! Get fired up!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし……！
やるわよリノ！
気合を入れなさい！！

text_block_list.name: Rino
text_block_list.text: Yes!!
text_block_list.orig_text: はい！！
